subject: integration
name: Esplora servers (Bitcoin)
summary: The Bitcoin node row that answers BTC_NET_0_1 from the public Esplora servers Orivon asks (mempool.space first, blockstream.info when the first cannot answer). Open source. It is 3, not 4: the servers are public and nothing checks what they return, so a lying server shows false balances and fees. They also see this computer's address and the addresses and transactions asked about. Judged here by its publisher.
